infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Overlap uses the camera so you can add photos to match memories.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Overlap needs photo access so you can add pictures to memories and your profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Overlap needs permission to save photos you take for memories.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Overlap uses your location to show nearby matches and plan trips.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Overlap uses your location to show nearby matches and plan trips.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Overlap uses your location to show nearby matches and plan trips.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Overlap does not record audio; this permission is only requested if a feature needs it.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Overlap can use Face ID to protect your account on this device.
